notes.title: Release Date Announcement and new Publisher
notes.notes:
Hi wishlisters and community members!

RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT

Thanks to all of you for so patiently waiting for the next news about Darkenstein 3D. 
The demo has been doing the rounds, and since its release, much has improved. 
The game is now finished, and it is ready to launch. 

The game will be available FOR FREE, no tricks, on October the 21stfor all of you to go into it and start your nazi killing campaign!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43246048/eb4608bc81b125d451202d5f96b4a0ec6820746c.png"]


A NEW PATH


But there is more good news, the PC version of the game will be published by the legendary Microprose.

What does this mean for the game?
The game will get better!

We are now looking at a longer-lived game, with more content to come.
DLCs will *not* be bite-sized and we will *not* nickel and dime you.

A first, smaller, expansion will be released so that you can, if you want, support the dev (me! hah), since the game is free.

After that, I’ll keep building longer story expansions, with (hopefully) a few more people joining the project. These DLCs will carry the story of the Hobo Guy and Gunther into new chapters for you to experience.


I am truly looking forward to all of you getting your hands on the final game, and I thank everyone again who has been waiting for such a long time.




Now is the time.
It’s coming.
Get Psyched!
